newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan's chipmaker United Micro up on ex-bonus.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's chipmaker United Micro up on ex-bonus.

text.p: United Microelectronics Corp, Taiwan's second largest microchip maker, surged in late trade on Wednesday after going ex-bonus, brokers said.
With 70 minutes left at 0250 GMT, United Micro was up T$5.5 to T$115.5.
"The company's ex-bonus issue has attracted investors, with large purchase orders being placed for United Micro's shares," said Ben Lee of Nomura Securities.
United Micro on Wednesday issued a T$3 per share bonus.
Brokers said the company's share price had risen steadily from the open, but there was a chance it would not rise the daily seven percent limit.
"The electronic sector had risen sharply for a long time and investors fear that the current consolidation will continue for a while," Lee said.
Electronics rose some 111 percent in the first six half of 1997, but have consolidated in recent sessions.
